text:
tess: quick update — calendar tweak for the upcoming review cycle, and a couple of exception paths. please read and flag if this affects your team :calendar:

samir: thanks tess — high level?

maria: yup urgent for EU folks?

tess: two main items: 1) EU local-holiday extension for self assessments, 2) one-off late-submission flow for folks on approved LOA/parental leave or recent week-long caregiving emergency.

devon: can you paste the new dates so i can tell my ICs?

`tess:` Updated dates (official):
- Self assessments: originally May 12 -> extended to May 15 for people in EU timezones only
- Peer feedback window: unchanged (May 20) — ask peers to submit earlier if possible
- Manager reviews due: May 28

jordan: how are we identifying EU folks? auto by profile timezone?

hr-bot: note: timezone is based on profile > location. If blank, defaults to org region (NA).

maria: ok will triage my team where timezone is blank. do we need manager approval for the LOA late exception?

`tess:` Yes — two-step: manager confirms approved LOA dates in People Ops Notes, then People Ops grants a 5-business-day extension on self-assessment for that person. For parental leave that spans >2 weeks, PMs can request up to 10 business days.

devon: good. any change to calibration slots? my managers were booked next week morning slots and asked for evening options

`tess:` We're opening two extra calibration blocks on May 26 (17:00–19:00 UTC) and May 27 (07:00–09:00 UTC) to cover timezone friction and late exceptions. Managers, please pick one slot and add "Calibration: <team name>" to the calendar event title.

samir: who owns reassigning reviewers if a manager is OOO during calibration window?

`tess:` If manager will be absent, they should nominate an acting reviewer in Lattice and ping people-ops. People Ops will confirm and add them to the calibration invite. Acting reviewer must be +peer level or above.

maria: what about contractors/temps moving to perm mid-cycle? they have partial review data

`tess:` Contractors converting to perm: manager should submit a short conversion note in People Ops Notes (dates and ramp expectations). We will include contractor period in the manager packet; calibration teams will see the conversion flag. No separate form — manager completes the standard review form and marks "conversion in cycle".

jordan: is there any automated reminder for folks who got the EU extension?

hr-bot: yes — automated nudges will go out to people with extended deadlines at 72h and 24h before the extended due date. Managers will get a summary email on the original due date showing who has extensions.

devon: can you confirm audit trail? managers ask frequently for receipts of exceptions

`tess:` All extension approvals and LOA confirmations live in People Ops Notes and are attached to the review packet. We keep an immutable audit log for 12 months.

samir: tiny ask — can we add a short blurb to the review kickoff that explains these exception rules? I keep getting the same Qs

`tess:` Great call. I'll add a 1-paragraph FAQ to the kickoff doc and pin it in #people-ops and the review calendar invites.

maria: thanks — i'll communicate to my managers and nudge any pending self-assessments in my team list.

jordan: thanks all :thumbsup:

hr-bot: deploy: review-cycle-reminders v2 scheduled for 2026-05-01 09:00 UTC

tess: closing the loop — if you need a manual exception for a unique case (hospitalization, severe emergency), escalate to people-ops@redwood.com with manager cc, we'll triage ASAP.

samir: noted. thanks tess and team!
